scanNote:
Grammar Book'ning 3-nazorat testi (75-bet). Workbook'ning 3-nazorat testi ham AYNAN shu unitlarni (5-6) qamraydi — ikkalasini birga yechish mumkin.

Farqi: Workbook testida uch bo'lim bor (lug'at, grammatika, muloqot), Grammar testida esa BITTA mashq — 'Choose the correct item', 20 band, faqat grammatika.

Bet burchagida QAYCHI belgisi (✂) bor — test qirqib olinadigan varaq.

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  B never       11  A her
   2  B children    12  C How much
   3  C Are         13  B like
   4  C Where       14  C in
   5  B in          15  A at
   6  A men         16  B How
   7  B Does        17  B always
   8  C What        18  A Who
   9  B on          19  C Do
  10  A many        20  B on


MAVZULAR BO'YIChA GURUHLASh:

  VAQT PREDLOGLARI (Unit 5) — 5, 9, 14,
     15, 20
  TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI (Unit 5) —
     1, 17
  SAVOL SO'ZLARI (Unit 6) — 4, 8, 16, 18
  'DO/DOES' SAVOLLARI (Unit 4, 6) —
     7, 13, 19
  NOTO'G'RI KO'PLIKLAR (Unit 6) — 2, 6
  'HOW MANY/MUCH' (Unit 8 ga tayyorgarlik)
     — 10, 12
  EGALIK (Unit 4) — 11
  'THIS/THAT/THESE/THOSE' (Unit 3) — 3


──── VAQT PREDLOGLARI ────

  ⚠ ASOSIY QOIDA:
     AT + SOAT     (at 9 am)
     ON + KUN/SANA (on Fridays,
                    on 2nd August)
     IN + OY/YIL/FASL/QISM
                   (in 1989, in the
                    evening)

  5  'Tom was born IN 1989.'   → YIL
  9  'go out with my friends ON Fridays.'
     → KUN
 14  'reads a magazine IN the evening.'
     → KUNNING QISMI
 15  'The plane leaves AT 9 am.' → SOAT
 20  'does the shopping ON Friday
     mornings.' → KUN

  ⚠ 14 va 20-BANDLAR NOZIK:
     'IN the evening' (kunning qismi)
     'ON Friday morningS' (aniq KUN
        aytilgani uchun 'on'!)

     Solishtiring:
        'in the morning'  (umuman ertalab)
        'ON Friday morning' (aniq kun)


──── TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI ────

  1  'Do you work on Saturday? —
      No, I NEVER work on Saturday.'
     KALIT: javob 'NO' bilan → NEVER.
     ('usually' va 'sometimes' — ijobiy,
      'No' ga zid.)

 17  'Pam ALWAYS wakes up very early. She
      starts work at 7 am.'
     KALIT: 7 da ish boshlaydi → DOIM erta
     turadi → ALWAYS.
     ('never'/'rarely' — mantiqsiz.)

  ⚠ O'RNI: asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN
     'I NEVER work.'  ✓
     'I work never.'  ✗


──── SAVOL SO'ZLARI ────

  4  'WHERE do koalas live? — In
      Australia.' → JOY
  8  'WHAT do you eat for dinner?' → NARSA
 16  'HOW long do elephants live?' →
     DAVOMIYLIK
 18  'WHO is your best friend? — Ann.' →
     ODAM


──── 'DO' va 'DOES' ────

  7  'DOES Susan go to school?'
     'Susan' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK → DOES.

 13  'They LIKE going to the cinema.'
     'They' — KO'PLIK → 'like' ('-s' YO'Q).
     ⚠ 'doesn't like' — 'they' bilan XATO.

 19  'DO Jim and Bill like playing
      football?'
     'Jim and Bill' — KO'PLIK → DO.


──── NOTO'G'RI KO'PLIKLAR ────

  2  'How many CHILDREN are there?'
     child → CHILDREN
     ⚠ 'children'S' — EGALIK shakli, bu
     yerda XATO.

  6  'There are three MEN in the car.'
     man → MEN
     ⚠ 'men'S' — egalik, XATO.
     ⚠ 'three man' — son bilan KO'PLIK
     kerak.


──── 'HOW MANY' va 'HOW MUCH' ────

 10  'How MANY legs does a cat have?'
     'legs' — SANALADIGAN ko'plik

 12  'How MUCH is an orange juice,
      please?'
     ⚠ Bu yerda 'how much' — NARX so'raydi!
     ('How much is it?' = qancha turadi?)


──── QOLGANLARI ────

  3  'ARE those your pencils?'
     'those' — KO'PLIK → ARE.
     ⚠ 'Isn't' — birlik va inkor, XATO.

 11  'Is this your sweater? —
      No, it's HER sweater.'
     'sweater' (OT) dan OLDIN → EGALIK
     SIFATI 'HER'.
     ⚠ 'hers' — otsiz ishlatiladi
        ('It's HERS.')
     ⚠ 'she' — ega shakli, otdan oldin
        kelmaydi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a koala     = koala
  a sweater   = sviter
  orange juice = apelsin sharbati
  a magazine  = jurnal
  to leave    = jo'namoq (samolyot)
  to wake up  = uyg'onmoq
  rarely      = kamdan-kam

items.textEn: 1  A: Do you work on Saturday?  B: No, I ................. work on Saturday.
items.uz: A: Shanba kuni ishlaysizmi? B: Yo'q, men shanba kuni hech qachon ishlamayman.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: javob 'NO' bilan boshlanadi → NEVER.

'usually' va 'sometimes' — IJOBIY ma'no,
'No' ga zid.

⚠ O'RNI: asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN
('I NEVER work' ✓ / 'I work never' ✗).

items.textEn: 2  How many ................. are there in your class?
items.whyUz:
'How MANY' dan keyin KO'PLIK kerak.

child → CHILDREN (noto'g'ri ko'plik).

⚠ 'children'S' — EGALIK shakli
('the children'S names'), bu yerda XATO.

items.textEn: 3  ................. those your pencils?
items.whyUz:
'those' — KO'PLIK → ARE.

'Is' — birlik ('Is THAT your pencil?').
'Isn't' — birlik VA inkor, savolga mos
kelmaydi.

items.textEn: 4  A: ................. do koalas live?  B: In Australia.
items.uz: A: Koalalar qayerda yashaydi? B: Avstraliyada.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: javob JOY ('In Australia') → WHERE.

'When' — vaqt; 'Why' — sabab.

⚠ YIL bilan 'IN'.

  AT + soat
  ON + kun/sana (on 2nd August)
  IN + oy/yil/fasl (in 1989, in August)

items.textEn: 6  There are three ................. in the car.
items.whyUz:
'three' (son) dan keyin KO'PLIK kerak.

man → MEN (noto'g'ri ko'plik).

⚠ 'men'S' — egalik shakli, XATO.

items.textEn: 7  ................. Susan go to school?
items.whyUz:
'Susan' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK → DOES.

Keyin ASOSIY shakl: 'Does she GO?'

'Do' — ko'plik bilan; 'Don't' — inkor.

items.textEn: 8  ................. do you eat for dinner?
items.whyUz:
NARSA (ovqat) so'raladi → WHAT.

'Who' — odam; 'When' — vaqt.

items.textEn: 9  I sometimes go out with my friends ................. Fridays.
items.uz: Men ba'zan juma kunlari do'stlarim bilan chiqaman.
items.whyUz:
KUN bilan 'ON':
  ON Friday / ON Fridays / ON Monday

⚠ 20-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda ham
'ON Friday mornings'.

items.textEn: 10  How ................. legs does a cat have?
items.whyUz:
'legs' — SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK → HOW MANY.

⚠ 12-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
'How MUCH' (narx).

items.textEn: 11  A: Is this your sweater?  B: No, it's ................. sweater.
items.uz: A: Bu sizning sviteringizmi? B: Yo'q, bu uning sviteri.
items.whyUz:
'sweater' (OT) dan OLDIN → EGALIK SIFATI
'HER'.

⚠ 'hers' — OTSIZ ishlatiladi ('It's HERS.').
⚠ 'she' — ega shakli, otdan oldin kelmaydi.

items.textEn: 12  ................. is an orange juice, please?
items.whyUz:
⚠ Bu yerda 'HOW MUCH' — NARX so'raydi!

'How much is it?' = qancha turadi?

'How many' — sanaladigan miqdor uchun
(10-band).

items.textEn: 13  They ................. going to the cinema at the weekend.
items.uz: Ular dam olish kunlari kinoga borishni yoqtirishadi.
items.whyUz:
'They' — KO'PLIK → 'LIKE' ('-s' YO'Q).

⚠ 'likes' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK bilan.
⚠ 'doesn't like' — 'they' bilan XATO
(va ma'nosi ham inkor).

'like + V-ing': 'like GOING'.

items.textEn: 14  He always reads a magazine ................. the evening.
items.whyUz:
⚠ KUNNING QISMI bilan 'IN':
  IN the morning / IN the afternoon /
  IN the evening

⚠ ISTISNO: 'AT night' (kechasi).

20-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda ANIQ KUN
aytilgani uchun 'ON Friday mornings'.

items.textEn: 15  The plane leaves ................. 9 am in the morning.
items.whyUz:
SOAT bilan DOIM 'AT':
  AT 9 am / AT 7 o'clock / AT noon

⚠ Gapda 'in the morning' ham bor — lekin
bo'sh joy SOAT oldida.

items.textEn: 16  ................. long do elephants live?
items.whyUz:
'HOW LONG' = qancha vaqt (davomiylik).

'Where long' / 'Why long' — mavjud emas.

'How' oilasi: how old, how many, how much,
how long, how often, how far.

items.textEn: 17  Pam ................. wakes up very early. She starts work at 7 am in the morning.
items.uz: Pam doim juda erta turadi. U ertalab soat 7 da ishni boshlaydi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: ikkinchi gap — 'She starts work AT
7 AM'.

Ertalab 7 da ish boshlash uchun DOIM erta
turish kerak → ALWAYS.

'never' va 'rarely' — mantiqan zid.

items.textEn: 18  A: ................. is your best friend?  B: Ann.
items.uz: A: Eng yaqin do'stingiz kim? B: Ann.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: javob ODAM ISMI ('Ann') → WHO.

'When' — vaqt; 'What' — narsa.

items.textEn: 19  ................. Jim and Bill like playing football?
items.uz: Jim va Bill futbol o'ynashni yoqtirishadimi?
items.whyUz:
'Jim and Bill' — KO'PLIK → DO.

⚠ 'Are' — 'like' fe'li bilan ishlatilmaydi
('Are they like?' XATO).
⚠ 'Doesn't' — birlik va inkor.

items.textEn: 20  Mum does the shopping ................. Friday mornings.
items.uz: Oyim juma kuni ertalab xarid qiladi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ ANIQ KUN aytilgani uchun 'ON':
  ON Friday mornings

⚠ 14-band bilan solishtiring:
  'IN the morning' (umuman ertalab)
  'ON Friday morning' (aniq kun)

'do the shopping' = xarid qilmoq.

groups.explanationUz: Bu testning eng ko'p tekshirilgan mavzusi.

items.derived: at 9 am, at 7 o'clock, at noon

groups.explanationUz: O'rni: asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN, 'to be' dan KEYIN.

patterns.exampleEn: I never work on Saturday. Pam always wakes up early.
patterns.exampleUz: Men shanba kuni hech qachon ishlamayman. Pam doim erta turadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ravish asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN;
'to be' dan KEYIN ('He IS NEVER late').

patterns.formula: AT [soat]  /  ON [kun]  /  IN [oy, yil, kunning qismi]
patterns.exampleEn: at 9 am / on Fridays / in 1989 / in the evening
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ ANIQ KUN aytilsa 'IN' emas, 'ON':
'ON Friday morningS'.

patterns.exampleEn: Does Susan go to school? Do Jim and Bill like playing football?
patterns.exampleUz: Syuzan maktabga boradimi? Jim va Bill futbol o'ynashni yoqtirishadimi?
patterns.explanationUz:
birlik → DOES;  ko'plik → DO.
Keyin DOIM ASOSIY shakl.

patterns.formula: HOW MANY + [ko'plik]?   /   HOW MUCH + [narx yoki sanalmaydigan]?
patterns.exampleEn: How many legs does a cat have? How much is an orange juice?
patterns.exampleUz: Mushukning nechta oyog'i bor? Apelsin sharbati qancha turadi?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'How much' NARX so'rash uchun ham
ishlatiladi.
